workflow: A subprocess is launched with an intentionally empty environment, removing configuration that suppresses known runtime leaks.
The subprocess initializes runtime components that retain allocations until shutdown.
Leak-detection instrumentation runs without the suppressing configuration and classifies those expected residual allocations as failures.
The subprocess exits unsuccessfully, so the environment-isolation check reports a sanitizer failure instead of completing normally.
summary: Empty environment exposes expected leaks to sanitizer
